briefing.geography: The Mare Claim rim, dome cluster, regolith fields, launch pad, and mass-driver rail beneath a dark sky.
goals: Build among the Mare Claim's dome cluster and rim pads.
Work the six regolith harvest grounds across the flat.
rules: Seven surveyed build grounds span the rim and mare flat.
The eastbound mass-driver rail crosses the southern footing.
Waves enter from the north, west, and east.
The claim is not made until four of the six regolith grounds are worked with air still in the suit.
Only one ground counts in each four-wave window, so the run is made in trips; a ground worked while her suit is empty counts for nothing.
Outside the domes there is no air. The hero lands six paces north of the dome cluster with sixty seconds in her suit, and the shadow leaves just one dome breathing.
An empty suit costs her five hit points every second until she reaches air.

buildables.meaning: Lights the dark and slows what it touches; radius 8wu.
Timber that holds. Bandits break it before you.
Works the river for you: 3g per cycle beside water.
Holds +150 gold above the pan cap.
Spark bolts, line-of-sight, 16wu range.
Write orders; the town's craftsmen answer. One per claim.

data.refillsIn: dome-cluster-pad-west, dome-cluster-pad-center, dome-cluster-pad-east
data.consequence: the hero's suit holds 60s of air outside pressurised ground and refills only inside it at 4s per second; once it empties she loses 5hp every second until she reaches air or dies

data.refillsIn: any dome-cluster-* pad that still holds air
data.consequence: the run cannot secure until 4 of the 6 regolith grounds have been panned with air still in the suit, and only ONE ground counts per 4-wave window, so the run is made in trips across the whole contract; a breathless pan still pays gold and counts for nothing

pilots.headless: the rider pilots the run's only hero
pilots.roomSeat: a headless roster seat pilots its own hero
pilots.soloBrowser: a human pilots the hero; MOVE_HERO refuses HERO_NOT_YOURS
